column3: MT 5:1–2; the following verses of this psalm are MT +1. NASB sets the title in braces before verse 1; “to the flutes” is rendered “for flute accompaniment,” and “my sighing” as “my groaning.”
NASB supplies “my prayer” after “I will order,” and adds “eagerly” to “watch.”
Close to the Hebrew; “everyone of bloods” is rendered “the man of bloodshed.”
“In the greatness of Your covenant loyalty” is rendered “by Your abundant lovingkindness”; “toward Your holy temple” is rendered “At Your holy temple,” and “in fear of You” as “in reverence for You.”
“In his mouth” is rendered “in what they say,” and “destructions” as “destruction itself.”
Close to the Hebrew; the last clause is rendered as a purpose clause, “That those who love Your name may exult.”
